statusText.planned: München goes live on the map once every step up to go-live is ticked.
statusText.live: Every step up to go-live is done. München is live on the map and in the failure simulator.

ui.illustrative: Durations and lead times are illustrative placeholders.

survey.title: Site survey
survey.goal: Know the building before anything is ordered.

check.walk: Walk through every room with the clinic manager.
check.cabinet: Choose the cabinet room: lockable, ventilated, not the X-ray room.
check.power: Plan a separate power circuit for the cabinet.
check.outlets: Count network outlets per room and plan the cable routes.
check.wifi: Measure Wi-Fi coverage in every room.
check.shielding: Note the X-ray room shielding and its effect on Wi-Fi.

pitfall.1: The best cabinet spot is promised for storage later.
pitfall.2: Lead shielding is only noticed when the Wi-Fi is weak.

isp.title: Internet order
isp.goal: The line has the longest lead time, so it is ordered first.

check.availability: Check availability at the exact address.
check.order: Order a business line with an SLA.
check.access: Arrange building access for the technician.

pitfall.1: The address is available, the building connection is not.
pitfall.2: The technician arrives and nobody has a key.

hardware.title: Hardware order
hardware.goal: Order the standard kit, sized for this clinic.

check.bom: Generate the bill of materials from the size of the clinic.
check.channel: Order Macs through the channel that enables automatic MDM enrolment.
check.licences: Include firewall, switch and MDM licences.
check.spares: Order spares: one access point, one card terminal.
check.leadtime: Check the longest lead time against the opening date.

pitfall.1: A cheaper non-standard switch: no spare on the shelf, a separate config.
pitfall.2: Macs from a retail shop that do not enrol by themselves.

staging.title: Pre-staging at HQ
staging.goal: Everything is configured and tested on the bench before it travels.

check.template: Apply the site template with site number 3 in the cloud dashboard.
check.firmware: Update firmware to the approved version.
check.mdm: Assign the Macs in the MDM and test the enrolment.
check.labels: Label every device with its room and port.
check.bench: Power the whole kit on the bench and test the VPN.

pitfall.1: Firmware gets updated on site during opening week.
pitfall.2: Unlabelled boxes: nobody knows which access point goes where.

install.title: Installation on site
install.goal: Cabinet, cabling and devices in place, the line handed over.

check.cabinet: Mount the cabinet with UPS, firewall and switch.
check.patch: Patch every port according to the port plan.
check.aps: Mount the access points where the survey says.
check.line: Take over the internet line and test it.
check.devices: Place and connect the devices in every room.

pitfall.1: Electrician and ISP technician booked for the same morning.

validation.title: Validation
validation.goal: Test every function before the first patient arrives.

check.workstations: Every Mac logs in and opens the practice software.
check.payment: Test payment on every card terminal.
check.xray: An X-ray test image reaches the archive.
check.lab: A lab test result arrives in the practice software.
check.failover: VPN failover test: pull the primary line, the tunnel comes back over LTE.
check.guest: Guest Wi-Fi isolation test: a guest phone reaches nothing inside.
check.backup: Backup and monitoring are active for the site.

pitfall.1: Only testing that devices are on, not that they work end to end.
pitfall.2: No failover test, so the first real outage becomes the test.

golive.title: Go-live
golive.goal: The first day with patients, with IT on site.

check.onsite: IT is on site from opening time.
check.logins: Every employee has logged in once.
check.alerts: Monitoring alerts for the site go to on-call.
check.known: A list of known small issues is with the clinic manager.

pitfall.1: Go-live on the same day as a new practice software version.

hypercare.title: Hypercare week
hypercare.goal: Fix teething problems fast and improve the template.

check.daily: Daily check-in with the clinic manager.
check.tickets: Review every ticket from the new clinic.
check.feedback: Write the lessons learned into the template.

pitfall.1: Fixes are made only in München, not in the template.

item.1: Cabinet: storage room, ground floor, lockable, ventilated.
item.2: Power: separate 16 A circuit planned for the cabinet.
item.3: Outlets: reception 6, each treatment room 2, office 3, X-ray 2, lab 2.
item.4: Cable route: ceiling void in the corridor, at most 45 m to the furthest room.
item.5: Wi-Fi: weak in treatment room 3 (−74 dBm), extra access point needed.
item.6: X-ray room: lead-lined walls, own wired outlet, no Wi-Fi expected inside.

item.1: Is fibre or cable available at exactly this address?
item.2: Which business tariff, with which bandwidth?
item.3: Is a static IP address included?
item.4: SLA: repair time and support hours?
item.5: Who supplies the router or modem, and can it run in bridge mode?
item.7: Does the technician need building access, and who lets them in?
item.8: Who signs the order, and who receives the invoice?

item.1: Start a continuous ping to HQ (ping 10.0.10.1) and a test payment.
item.2: Pull the fibre cable at the firewall.
item.3: Expected: LTE takes over and the tunnel is back within about a minute (illustrative).
item.4: Payment and practice software keep working; note anything that did not.
item.5: Plug the fibre back in and check that the firewall returns to it.

item.1: 07:00 IT on site, every device on, dashboard green.
item.2: 07:30 Short briefing with the team: whom to call, what to report.
item.3: 08:00 First patients; IT at reception for the first hour.
item.4: 12:00 Go through tickets and open questions.
item.5: 18:00 Short review with the clinic manager.

item.1: Treatment room 3 needed its own access point: added to the survey sheet.
item.2: Label printer driver missing in the MDM profile: fixed in the template.
item.3: The line came two weeks late: order 12 weeks ahead, not 8.
item.4: The team asked for a one-page login and Wi-Fi guide: added to onboarding.
